_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json. ADR-022 consumes docudesk's financial-document-field-extraction contract over the NC event bus (event + one outbound HTTP request); no OCR engine in shillinq.
_meta.description: Adds the extraction-draft field set to SupplierInvoice and Receipt: fieldConfidence (per-field 0..1 map), overallConfidence (aggregate 0..1), extractedFieldsOriginal (immutable snapshot of the docudesk-extracted values + confidence, kept even after a correction so the original is never silently lost, REQ-RXC-004), humanCorrected (list of field names the operator overrode), extractionStatus (pending-review | confirmed), and sourceDocumentUri (docudesk FK URI, REQ-DA-002 shape). Seeds two SupplierInvoice extraction drafts (high- and low-confidence) and one Receipt extraction draft per design.md.

fieldConfidence.description: Per-field extraction confidence (0..1), keyed by field name, as reported by docudesk's nl.conduction.docudesk.extraction.completed event. Null/absent for records not created from an extraction.
fieldConfidence.title: Field Confidence

overallConfidence.description: Aggregate extraction confidence (0..1) reported by docudesk. Gates whether BillImportModal offers one-click commit or requires explicit review; never bypasses human confirmation.
overallConfidence.title: Overall Confidence

extractedFieldsOriginal.description: Immutable snapshot of the field values + fieldConfidence as first extracted by docudesk. Set once when the draft is created (or refreshed by a re-request); a later operator correction MUST NOT overwrite this snapshot, so the original extracted value and its confidence are always retrievable.
extractedFieldsOriginal.title: Extracted Fields (Original)

humanCorrected.description: Names of fields the operator edited before commit, overriding the extracted value. Computed server-side by ExtractionPrefillService::recordCorrection so the provenance cannot be spoofed or silently dropped by the client.
humanCorrected.title: Human-corrected Fields

extractionStatus.description: pending-review = an uncommitted extraction draft awaiting operator confirmation; confirmed = the operator has reviewed/corrected and committed it. Absent for records never created from an extraction.
extractionStatus.title: Extraction Status

sourceDocumentUri.description: FK URI to the docudesk source document this invoice was extracted from (bookkeeping-document-attachment-integration REQ-DA-002). No file bytes are stored in shillinq.
sourceDocumentUri.title: Source Document URI
